verses.gurmukhi: ੯ : ਗੁਰਸਿਖ - ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 9 : gursikh - hi(n)dhoo musalamaan to(n) u'chaa hai

en.bdb: Gursikh is above the feelings of Hindu and Muslim -
Hindus and Muslims have started two separate ways (of life).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਜਹਬ ਵਰਨ ਗਣਾਇਂਦੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: majahab varan ganai(n)dhe gur peer sadhaae|

en.bdb: Muslims count their mazahabs (sects) and Hindus count their varnas (castes) and call themselves pirs and gurus respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਪਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sikh mureedh pakha(n)dd kar upadhes dhiraRaae|

en.bdb: Through pretension and hypocrisy they make people their followers (Sikhs and murtils) whom they give instruction.
Adoring Ram and and Rahtm they remain conceited in their sense of ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਕਾ ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸੀ ਪੂਜ ਜਾਰਤ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: makaa ga(n)g banaarasee pooj jaarat aae|

en.bdb: Separately, they go for pilgrimage and worship to Mecca, Ganges and Banaras.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਜੇ ਵਰਤ ਨਮਾਜ਼ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: roje varat namaaz kar dda(n)ddaut karaae|

en.bdb: They observe rozas, vrats (fasts), namaz and prostration (Muslim and Hindu way of worship).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh rom na pujanee jo aap gavaae ||9||

en.bdb: They all are not equal to even one trichome of a Gum's Sikh who has effaced his sense of ego.
